listing.name: Persona 2: Innocent Sin — Persona2Recomp (jermspeaks)
listing.summary: Experimental project. This in-development version 0.1.0 uses static recompilation with game-specific changes. A full playthrough and platform acceptance have not been recorded. Generated-code and framework licences remain separate. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Persona2InnocentSin Japan SLPS02100 v1.0 reference image; recorded CUE identifies Gemini English translation v1.0a. game.toml hashes define acceptance; base Japanese identity alone not proof every translation works.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the documented build recipe that starts without generated output. Build the emitters and regenerate C from your own Japanese SLPS02100 v1.0 image with the referenced GeminiEnglish v1.0a translation, then build psx-runtime with CMake and Ninja. The first-run wizard still needs a compatible disc. Upstream separates generated-code and third-party terms from its root GPL; these instructions grant no publishing, redistribution or managed-package permission.
